Description: "Adjust single comments and signatures sizes in stylesheet to increase comments row height and decrease signatures height"
Instruction: "Change minHeight of comments rows and margins/height of signatures rows in styles"
ReplacementContent:
"    singleCommentsContainer: { marginBottom: 2 },
    singleCommentsBox: { borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#000', borderRadius: 2, flexDirection: 'column' },
    singleCommentTermRow: { flexDirection: 'row', borderBottomWidth: 1, borderColor: '#000', minHeight: 48, alignItems: 'flex-start', paddingTop: 2, paddingHorizontal: 4 },
    singleCommentTermRowLast: { flexDirection: 'row', minHeight: 48, alignItems: 'flex-start', paddingTop: 2, paddingHorizontal: 4 },
    singleCommentLabel: { width: '15%', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 'bold' },
    singleCommentValue: { flex: 1, fontSize: 11 },

    singleSignaturesContainer: { marginBottom: 2, paddingHorizontal: 30 },
    singleSignatureRow: { flexDirection: 'row', marginBottom: 1, alignItems: 'center' },
    singleSignatureLabel: { fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: 'bold', width: 40 },
    singleSignatureLine: { flex: 1, borderBottomWidth: 1, borderBottomColor: '#000', height: 4 },"
TargetContent:
"    singleCommentsContainer: { marginBottom: 4 },
    singleCommentsBox: { borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#000', borderRadius: 2, flexDirection: 'column' },
    singleCommentTermRow: { flexDirection: 'row', borderBottomWidth: 1, borderColor: '#000', minHeight: 32, alignItems: 'flex-start', paddingTop: 2, paddingHorizontal: 4 },
    singleCommentTermRowLast: { flexDirection: 'row', minHeight: 32, alignItems: 'flex-start', paddingTop: 2, paddingHorizontal: 4 },
    singleCommentLabel: { width: '15%', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 'bold' },
    singleCommentValue: { flex: 1, fontSize: 11 },

    singleSignaturesContainer: { marginBottom: 4, paddingHorizontal: 30 },
